question: Six people, F, G, H, I, J and S, are sitting in a straight line facing north (but not necessarily in the same order). No one sits to the right of F. Only three people sit between F and J. Only two people sit between J and G. H sits second to the left of I. How many people sit between H and S?
solution:
Six people, F, G, H, I, J and S, are sitting in a straight line facing north (but not necessarily in the same order).

 
• No one sits to the right of F.
 
• Only three people sit between F and J.
 
• Only two people sit between J and G.
 
• H sits second to the left of I
